correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the directed-pair graph and tested induced quadruple connectivity by testing all bipartitions, independently finding 48 connected and 447 disconnected four-sets. Every seven-set lies in a facet; the literal complement predicate gives the complete two-skeleton plus the 48 tetrahedra in the dual. Replayed all 48 supplied free triangle/tetrahedron pairs and checked the eleven-edge spanning tree and 55 unit-edge relations, yielding a simply connected two-complex with reduced Euler characteristic 117. Hurewicz and homological Whitehead give the dual wedge. Combinatorial Alexander duality gives sole reduced H₇ of rank 117 on the original complex; its full six-skeleton gives five-connectivity, so Hurewicz and H₆=0 upgrade it to six-connectivity and give the seven-sphere wedge. The only graph triangles are the four vertex blocks; the unique reversed-edge connection between each pair of blocks determines each vertex from its two block labels, so the permutation action on blocks is faithful and exhausts the automorphism group. Independently evaluated the original reduced Lefschetz sum for all 24 permutations by enumerating unions of vertex cycles: after negating the reduced Euler trace, a fixed face formed by r cycles contributes (−1)^r, including the empty face. This returned (117,7,1,3,1). Irreducible character inner products with class sizes (1,6,3,8,6) give (8,4,16,13,9).
residual_risks: Integral equivalences are nonequivariant; the character decomposition is rational, not a classification of the integral S₄-module.

value.rationale: The truncated tetrahedron is a canonical highly symmetric small graph whose triangles put it outside the higher-girth classification. At the natural next cut level after the three-cut result, the precise integral types for both dual partners and the full tetrahedral character distinguish homotopy and symmetry phenomena that an Euler count would not record. The eight-dimensional fixed subspace is genuine representation information, not just a table enumeration of connected quadruples.
residual_risks: No general cubic-family, shellability or equivariant sphere-wedge conclusion is claimed.
